harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a router between two VLANs: eth1 (192.168.10.1/24) toward node2 and eth2 (192.168.20.1/24) toward node3, with IPv4 forwarding enabled globally and per-interface. node2 (192.168.10.2/24) and node3 (192.168.20.2/24) each got a static route to the other's subnet via node1. Verified bidirectional ping across the VLAN boundary (TTL=63 confirming routing through node1). Persisted config: node1 via /etc/network/interfaces.d and /etc/sysctl.d; node2/node3 via /etc/systemd/network/10-enp8s0.network. Completed the mandatory restart protocol — rebooted node1, node2, then node3 sequentially, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and verified the VLAN addressing, forwarding sysctls, and cross-VLAN connectivity all persisted and recovered after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 network topology and interface state
Identified eth1<->node2 and eth2<->node3 VLAN link pairing via ping tests
Assigned 192.168.10.1/24 and 192.168.20.1/24 to node1 eth1/eth2
Assigned 192.168.10.2/24 to node2 enp8s0 and 192.168.20.2/24 to node3 enp8s0
Enabled net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding on node1
Added static routes on node2 and node3 for the opposite subnet via node1
Verified bidirectional cross-VLAN ping (node2<->node3)
Persisted node1 interface config in /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1-eth2 and forwarding sysctls in /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb-forwarding.conf
Persisted node2/node3 static IP+route config in /etc/systemd/network/10-enp8s0.network and applied via networkctl reload/reconfigure
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3, polling each until exec access returned
Verified changed boot_id, restored IP/forwarding config, and recovered cross-VLAN ping after each node's restart

evidence.requirement: node1 given routed interfaces in each VLAN (eth1/eth2 addressed)
evidence.summary: node1 eth1 assigned 192.168.10.1/24 and eth2 assigned 192.168.20.1/24

evidence.requirement: Correct VLAN pairing identified before configuring
evidence.summary: node2 reached 192.168.10.1 (node1 eth1) and node3 reached 192.168.20.1 (node1 eth2), confirming link pairing

evidence.requirement: IPv4 forwarding enabled on node1 for both VLAN interfaces
evidence.summary: net.ipv4.ip_forward, conf.eth1.forwarding, conf.eth2.forwarding all set to 1

evidence.requirement: node2/node3 routes to reach the opposite subnet via node1
End-to-end cross-VLAN reachability between node2 and node3
evidence.summary: Bidirectional ping success with TTL=63 confirming traffic routed through node1

evidence.requirement: Configuration persistence across reboot
evidence.summary: Static interface/route config written to node1 /etc/network/interfaces.d and /etc/sysctl.d, and node2/node3 /etc/systemd/network/10-enp8s0.network; applied cleanly via networkctl

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 39fdb9ab... plus working forwarding sysctls and VLAN addresses

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; node became unreachable then returned with new boot_id 5f3ffff4...

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered state post-restart
evidence.summary: eth1/eth2 addresses and forwarding sysctls restored from persisted config; cross-VLAN ping recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 63f96994... and working enp8s0 address

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to e7b49420... confirming restart

evidence.requirement: node2 recovered state post-restart
evidence.summary: enp8s0 address and route restored, cross-VLAN ping 0% loss

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id cf34dc87... and working enp8s0 address

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 30218283... confirming restart

evidence.requirement: node3 recovered state and final full cross-VLAN verification
evidence.summary: enp8s0 address and route restored; bidirectional ping between node2 and node3 succeeded with 0% loss after all restarts
